_note: Saudi tax parameters used by the engine. Rates change — review against ZATCA / GOSI publications at least yearly and before each annual close. Source references are in docs/KSA-COMPLIANCE.md.

wht._note: Income Tax Law Art. 68 / Implementing Regulations Art. 63 — payments to non-residents from a KSA source. Due by the 10th of the month after payment.

gosi._note: Contribution base = basic + housing, capped. Saudis: annuities (pension) + SANED (unemployment) + occupational hazards. Non-Saudis: occupational hazards only, employer-paid. New Social Insurance Law (from 3 Jul 2024) raises the annuity rate for NEW Saudi registrants by 0.5 % per side every July from 2025 to 11 % in 2028.

eosb._note: Labour Law Art. 84: half a month's wage per year for the first 5 years, one month's wage per year thereafter, on the last wage (basic + housing + transport by default). Formula-based accrual; IAS 19 projected-unit-credit valuation should be obtained for the audited year-end.

zakat._note: 2.5 % on the zakat base for a Hijri year; pro-rated to the Gregorian year (365/354). Zakat Implementing Regulations effective for fiscal years starting on/after 1 Jan 2024.
